title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Gum Swelling
intro: Herbal creams for gum swelling are topical treatments that contain plant-based ingredients to reduce inflammation and promote healing of swollen gums. These creams offer numerous benefits, including being non-invasive, easy to apply, and free from harsh chemicals, making them a popular alternative to conventional treatments. Examples of herbal creams used to treat gum swelling include aloe vera cream, which has anti-inflammatory properties, chamomile cream, which soothes and calms the gums, and tea tree oil cream, which has antimicrobial properties to combat underlying infections. Other herbal creams, such as peppermint, eucalyptus, and ginkgo biloba, also help to reduce swelling, ease pain, and promote healing due to their anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams have been traditionally used to treat gum swelling, also known as gingivitis, due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. This herbal preparation helps to reduce inflammation and prevent infections in the gums, thereby alleviating the symptoms of gum swelling. The bioactive constituents of Echinacea purpurea creams, including alkylamides and glycoproteins, work together to modulate the immune response and reduce the severity of gum inflammation. The benefits of using Echinacea purpurea creams to treat gum swelling include reduced pain and swelling, improved oral health, and a lower risk of complications such as tooth loss or infection.

By reducing swelling and promoting healing, Aloe barbadensis creams can help to alleviate pain and discomfort associated with gum inflammation, ultimately promoting oral health and preventing further complications. The benefits of using Aloe barbadensis creams for gum swelling include reduced inflammation, improved healing, and a lower risk of infection, making it a popular natural remedy for oral health issues.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the Iranian journal of basic medical sciences, Aloe barbadensis creams for gum swelling may be effective in reducing gingival inflammation and bleeding, as well as inhibiting dental plaque formation, due to its anti-inflammatory properties and other mechanisms.
